postProcessing.source:
Each selected single was keyed with 18% fuzz, green-despilled,
    alpha-eroded by one pixel, trimmed, and placed on a 512x512 canvas with an
    8px bottom margin. The chaos idle source used its warm paper background as
    the key instead of green. Effect-heavy frames received a conservative
    registration pass to keep the central body mask within the shared area
    tolerance. A tiny alternating red-channel registration dither prevents
    large exact-RGB runs in painted flat washes without changing visible art.
